years_experience: Trading since 2006 (locally owned and operated by Simon and Fiona Cavanagh)
other_info: Timber and building supply merchant, 138 Napier Road, Palmerston North (BuildLink Group). Main focus: pole sheds. Also large clear span sheds, through post and rail fencing, timber for decking (mainly DIYers), and a small made-to-order range (chicken coops, picnic tables etc, built by in-house builder). Customers: mostly rural/farmers, then landscapers, then DIY. Services most of the lower North Island. Not advertising general hardware, ply/gib or commodity timber for now. Logo still needed (compulsory).
